translations.web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
translations.bsb: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
translations.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
translations.asv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around I said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.
